name: Layer3 USD live spot collateral valuation
summary: Loan.supply valued deposited BTCB with PancakeSwap Router V2's current two-token quote and minted LUSD from that quote. The successful receipt temporarily displaced the referenced BTCB/USDT reserves, so the LUSD minted against 0.001515366635982742 BTCB exceeded the independently valued collateral retained by the Loan contract.
notes: setInfo configured BTCB to pay LUSD, with redeemFee 500, supplyRatio 5000 and dailyRate 3 in the four consecutive mapping slots. This was the first and only pre-incident BTCB configuration and made the live BTCB/USDT quote path operational; later setInfo calls addressed other tokens.

The LUSD pool's archive USDT balance falls by 9,800.402958646947704433 in the incident block. The receipt decomposes that change exactly: 100.004111822928037800 USDT is paired with endogenous L3 and capitalized into 16.110436463978777246 Cake-LP minted to and retained by the pool, while 9,700.398846824019666633 USDT leaves the victim entity for the attacker helper. The Loan contract simultaneously retains the attacker's exact 0.001515366635982742-BTCB deposit. Immediately before the loss, Pancake pair 0x3f803ec2b816ea7f06ec76aa2b6f2532f9892d62 held 39,642.343651114056995536 USDT and 1.308898664806062396 BTCB, with reserve timestamp 1688739223. The reserve-implied price is the exact ratio 39,642.343651114056995536 / 1.308898664806062396, approximately $30,286.793559368329840326123063709099959686246757061248349441343945552583311207193 per BTCB; DefiLlama independently corroborates it with a preceding $30,277 observation at 1688739768. The exact collateral-credit rational is (0.001515366635982742 × 39,642.343651114056995536) / 1.308898664806062396 dollars, approximately $45.895596470763762791825835613590524256663991716609547910720118830076326619601439. Subtracting that rational from the external USDT outflow gives net loss approximately $9,654.5032503532559038411741643864094757433360082833904520892798811699236733803986. No BTCB was returned to the attacker: the collateral stayed in Loan until protocol manager transaction 0xe5dfbf3d1f27f00efee13b465d877ac7d5bef7c978016659aeb9b3ac8e9c0050 later swept the aggregate 0.001533265791594517-BTCB balance to 0x81f319f3cba6abb3ba555b6e6cf4debb1fd93568. That later protocol disposition does not change the incident-time credit. Five nested flash lenders received their USDT principal back; the six preceding calls reverted; and the next successful EOA transaction forwarded the already measured 9,464.716730420359231245-USDT proceeds without returning assets to the victim.
